name: The Conch Inn & Marina
primary_cta: Send to the dock office (slip letter, prefilled email to info@conchinn.com); rooms: Book online (RezExpert)
brand_truth: Since 1972 the Conch Inn has been Marsh Harbour's front door from the water: the dock you tie up to and walk into town from, rebuilt after Dorian.
buyer: Cruising sailors, charter catamaran crews and US East Coast boat owners planning on a phone; second, hotel guests flying into Marsh Harbour.

direction.why: Their office asks boaters to write an email with boat type, name, LOA, beam, draft and dates; the page is that letter, filled in live and answered with their published rates. No tape or script: clean paper, letterhead, brass for the reply.

tier_why: Their own photographs are excellent and large; the wow is the living letter and its live reply. 3D would add nothing a captain needs.
concept_type: booking: slip request letter with published rates + RezExpert room booking

images.credit: The Conch Inn & Marina (docks at sunset (hero))

changes_applied: Ashore is a full-bleed Snappas photo with the walk-to-town list in a paper caption panel

house rules as a one-column P.S. running into the dock-office card
hero gets Staying ashore? Book a room online; the total is in brass
dates are typeset italic blanks over a hidden native picker
paper warmed to #f5f4f0, brass letterhead rule

critic_note: Final critic not run (plan-gate workflow); self-critique against art-director section 7 and craft checklist A/B done.

history, 73 slips, 30 ft beam and airport distance only on other websites
pitch_line: A captain fills in one sentence, sees your published dockage for their boat and dates, and sends your office exactly the email you ask for; hotel guests are one tap from your booking engine.
assumptions: Monthly rate $2.25/ft read as the 30+ night tier; the letter defers the monthly total to the office
dockage VAT not stated on their site (moorings say +VAT)
photo-to-room matching by Wix alt text and order on their rooms page
73 slips, 1972, March 2021 reopening, 3 miles to airport from bahamasmarinas.com; 30 ft catamaran beam and live music at Snappas from noonsite.com
boat-type options in the letter are generic categories
